memory_candidates: A plan phase written as CONDITIONAL on an earlier decision gate needs its branch confirmed from that gate's own recorded measurement before any work starts, and its non-taken branch's tasks annotated as skipped-because-counterfactual rather than silently left unchecked. The failure mode worth naming is not skipping them but executing them: a FAIL-branch verdict line written on a PASS branch puts a false claim into a durable record, which is strictly worse than an absent one.

An evidence probe cited as the Evidence column of a landed Reasoned Exclusions record is a durable obligation, not a scratch file: if it is not in check-evidence-probes.sh's WIRED/WIRED_REPO list, no gate reaches it and it rots silently. A probe left under a task directory additionally leaves version control entirely when /todo archives that task, because .gitignore excludes specs/archive/ -- the guard then fails on every clean checkout while staying green for whoever already has the file.
